dedupe_keys.name: accelerometer log from site a landslide experiment

description: TU Delft provides an accelerometer log from the Site-A landslide experiment. A mechanical excavator sequentially triggered slope failures by undercutting the slope toe. The accelerometer installed at the slope crest monitored surrounding soil accelerations. The source identifies the experiment in Chapter 5 of the sand-slope thesis. Coverage: The test-site location is unstated.; 2018. Format: xlsx; pdf; dat; txt. Access: public native descriptive metadata. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Current file access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: Exact observation dates, units, sampling interval, calibration and missing-record handling are unstated. The source-defined parent collection concerns breaching flowslides during mining activities. Simulation use is interpreted as mining slope-hazard and geotechnical calibration evidence; no independent model validation is asserted. Related resources in the native collection have separate identities.
